categories.name: Pharmacology
categories.description: Mixed review of every pharmacology topic below: drug classes, safe administration, adverse effects, antidotes and patient teaching.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Antihypertensives
categories.description: ACE inhibitors, ARBs, beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, alpha agonists/blockers and vasodilators.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Antidiuretic
categories.description: Loop, thiazide, potassium-sparing, osmotic and carbonic anhydrase inhibitor diuretics, plus antidiuretic hormone drugs.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Antianginal
categories.description: Nitrates, beta blockers, calcium channel blockers and other drugs for angina.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Antiepileptic
categories.description: Antiepileptic drugs, therapeutic drug levels, status epilepticus and safety teaching.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Anticoagulants
categories.description: Heparins, warfarin, direct oral anticoagulants, reversal agents, antiplatelets and thrombolytics.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Antiemetics
categories.description: Serotonin blockers, dopamine antagonists, antihistamines, anticholinergics and other antinausea drugs.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Acid control
categories.description: Antacids, H2 receptor antagonists, proton pump inhibitors and other acid-controlling drugs.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Thyroid and antithyroid
categories.description: Thyroid replacement and antithyroid drugs, thyroid labs, myxedema and thyroid storm.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Antidiabetics
categories.description: Insulins, oral and injectable non-insulin antidiabetic drugs and hypoglycemia management.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Anti-inflammatory
categories.description: NSAIDs, salicylates, COX-2 inhibitors and antigout drugs.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Analgesics
categories.description: Opioids, opioid antagonists, acetaminophen and adjuvant analgesics.

categories.name: Pharmacology - Heart failure
categories.description: Digoxin, ACE inhibitors/ARBs, ARNI, beta blockers, diuretics and inotropes for heart failure.
